next.reason: 1985: REPLACE 'Pseudo-text-1 must contain one or more text words.' §2023:7.2.4.3 SR3: 'Pseudo-text-1 shall contain one or more text-words, at least one of which shall be neither a separator comma nor a separator semicolon.' The added clause already exists in 1985 XII.3.3 SR7 ('must not consist entirely of a separator comma or a separator semicolon'); SR3 merges 1985 SR3 and SR7. Same programs refused.
